stringcase-camel.root_cause: Whole-input lowercasing destroys existing internal capitals.
stringcase-camel.explanation: Reproduced historical regression in authentic accepted upstream f79de04e. Base README explicitly says camelcase(FooBarBaz) returns fooBarBaz; actual output is foobarbaz. The unchanged test independently fails on FooBar -> foobar (12 passed / 1 failed). Both formal trials reproduce it. Authored alternate preserves capitals and joins reported spaced words; all assertions and baseline tests pass. This is a candidate/reference behavior disagreement, not a check error, and zero additional independent detection because ordinary checks already fail. No new upstream discovery claimed.

flatten-recursive.explanation: Both retained reference and authored-alternative ordinary commands fail before tests can run: MODULE_NOT_FOUND for array-flatten imported by unchanged test.js. Independent dense-array checks pass for both. This is unsupported offline test setup, not a production defect or false alarm. No formal candidate audits were performed.

flatten-for.explanation: Intake rejects the immutable base tree because benchmark/code/arr-flatten-0.1.0 (do-while).js contains characters outside the accepted path contract.
